Business event: A shareholder transfers funds to an SHH cash account, safe or bank account.
Debit logic: Dr 111001/111002/111003/111010/111011 (cash or bank account receiving the funds)
Credit logic: Cr 221001–221004 Shareholder Loan, or 222001–222004 Shareholder Current Account, or 310010 Capital Contributions Pending Registration — per the approved classification of the funding instrument
Required dimensions: Project (mandatory) · Cost Center (mandatory) · Shareholder (mandatory) · Funding Source · Funding Batch · Cash/Bank account (mandatory) · Actual Payment Source (audit only)
Required documents: Transfer advice or receipt voucher; shareholder instruction where the classification is loan vs capital
Control rules: VR-01 Dr=Cr · VR-06 cash account mandatory · VR-08 counterparty mandatory · VR-20 funding is never revenue

Transaction Type (EN): Direct Payment by Shareholder on Behalf of SHH
النوع (عربي): دفع مباشر من المساهم نيابة عن الشركة
Business event: The shareholder (or Eidan Company on his behalf) pays a vendor, contractor or cost directly without the cash passing through an SHH account.
Debit logic: Dr the final economic account — 115xxx CIP, 116xxx acquisition, 118xxx fixed asset, 112xxx advance, 510xxx/610xxx expense
Credit logic: Cr 221001–221004 Shareholder Loan of the funding shareholder
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Shareholder · Counterparty (payee) · Funding Source · Funding Batch · Actual Payment Source · CAPEX/OPEX
Required documents: Supplier invoice or receipt, and the funding party's payment evidence
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-08 · VR-11 no cash account may be used · VR-30 duplicate test against the cash-funded population

Business event: A party who is not a shareholder funds a payment and the board approves recognition as a payable to that party.
Debit logic: Dr 111002 cash / safe, or the final economic account where paid directly
Credit logic: Cr 211090 Other Payables, with the funding party as counterparty
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty (mandatory) · Funding Source
Required documents: Board minute approving the recognition; payment evidence
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-08 · VR-21 third-party funding may not be posted to 221xxx

Business event: Cash received from a customer, refund, deposit return or other non-funding source.
Credit logic: Cr 112001 receivable, 410xxx revenue, 112040 deposits or the relevant account
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Cash/Bank account · Counterparty
Required documents: Receipt voucher (RV)
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-06 · VR-22 revenue may only be credited to 410xxx

Business event: Payment made straight out of a safe or bank account to a payee, with the cost recognised immediately.
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty · Cash/Bank account · CAPEX/OPEX
Required documents: Payment voucher (PV) plus invoice or receipt
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-06 · VR-08 · VR-13 document status required

Business event: Movement of funds between two SHH cash, safe or bank accounts.
Debit logic: Dr the receiving 111xxx account (or 111020 Cash in Transit where the movement spans periods)
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · both Cash/Bank accounts
Required documents: Internal transfer voucher
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-06 · VR-23 both legs must be cash accounts · VR-24 self-transfer forbidden

Business event: Cash is issued from a project safe to a named custodian against a defined purpose and settlement deadline.
Debit logic: Dr 112030/112032 (Abdul Hamid), 112035/112037 (Yas Jassim), 112010 employee advances, 112020 contractor advances, 112021 supplier advances
Credit logic: Cr 111002 or the paying cash account
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Responsibility Center · Advance Holder (mandatory) · Cash account · Funding Batch
Required documents: Advance request with purpose, amount and settlement deadline; approval
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-07 advance holder mandatory · VR-25 issuing an advance may never debit an expense or CIP account

Business event: A custodian passes part of his custody to an employee or a secondary holder.
Debit logic: Dr 112010 Employee Advances (or the receiving advance account)
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Responsibility Center · both advance holders
Required documents: Written instruction of the originating custodian

Business event: Approved documents prove that custody funds were spent on capitalisable project works.
Debit logic: Dr 115xxx Concession Assets under Construction (or 116xxx / 118xxx as approved)
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Responsibility Center · Advance Holder · Counterparty · CAPEX/OPEX = CAPEX · Asset Class · Handover Requirement
Required documents: Invoice, receipt, contract or certificate; approval of the classification
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-26 the advance account must be the credit side · VR-27 no expense/CIP account may ever be credited to settle an advance

النوع (عربي): تسوية سلفة — نفقة تشغيلية أو إدارية
Business event: Approved documents prove that custody funds were spent on operating or administrative costs.
Debit logic: Dr 510xxx Direct Operating Costs or 610xxx Administrative Expenses
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Responsibility Center · Advance Holder · Counterparty · CAPEX/OPEX = OPEX
Required documents: Invoice, receipt or approved expense claim

Business event: Custody funds were spent acquiring a movable asset retained by SHH.
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Advance Holder · Counterparty · Asset Class = Fixed Asset (Retained)
Required documents: Purchase invoice and asset receipt

Transaction Type (EN): Reclassification of Custody Spend to Personal Receivable
Business event: Spend from custody is determined not to be a company cost and becomes personally recoverable from the custodian.
Debit logic: Dr 112101 / 112102 Personal Receivable of that person
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Responsibility Center · Advance Holder
Required documents: Management determination naming the items and amounts
Approval workflow: Senior Accountant → Finance Manager (board approval where material)
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-26 · VR-28 personal receivable requires a named individual

النوع (عربي): إعادة نقد غير مستخدم من السلفة
Business event: The custodian returns unspent cash to the safe or bank.
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Advance Holder · Cash account
Required documents: Receipt voucher

Business event: An advance payment is made to a contractor or supplier ahead of certified work or delivery.
Credit logic: Cr 111xxx cash or 221xxx where paid directly by the shareholder
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty (mandatory) · Contract · Work Package · Funding Batch
Required documents: Signed contract or purchase order and the advance guarantee where required
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-08 · VR-29 a contract reference is required above the approved threshold

Business event: An engineering certificate approves work executed by a contractor.
Debit logic: Dr 115xxx CIP (or 510xxx where the work is operating in nature)
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty · Contract · Work Package · CAPEX/OPEX · Asset Class
Required documents: Signed progress certificate and measurement sheet
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-08 · VR-29 · VR-31 certified value may not exceed contract value plus approved variations

Business event: Part of a contractor advance is recovered against certified work at the contractual recovery rate.
Required dimensions: Counterparty · Contract · Project
Required documents: Certificate showing the recovery calculation
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-32 cumulative recovery may not exceed the advance issued

Business event: Retention is withheld from a certified amount pending completion.
Required dimensions: Counterparty · Contract · Project
Required documents: Certificate showing the retention calculation
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-33 retention percentage must match the contract master

Business event: A net amount is paid to the contractor or supplier.
Required dimensions: Counterparty · Contract · Cash/Bank account · Project · Cost Center
Required documents: Payment voucher, certificate, invoice and tax/deduction evidence
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-06 · VR-08 · VR-34 payment may not exceed the outstanding payable

Business event: A supplier invoice is recognised before payment.
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty · CAPEX/OPEX
Required documents: Supplier invoice and goods receipt
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-08 · VR-13 · VR-35 duplicate invoice number per counterparty is blocked

Business event: A payment is made towards acquiring an interest in a project (currently PRJ-02 / Al-Rashidiya).
Debit logic: Dr 116001 Advance Payments for Acquisition of PRJ-02 Interest
Credit logic: Cr 112030 advance account, 111xxx cash or 221xxx shareholder loan as applicable
Required dimensions: Project = PRJ-02 · Cost Center · Counterparty · Funding Batch
Required documents: Share purchase agreement or payment instruction and board approval
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-36 acquisition payments may not be expensed

Business event: The acquisition completes and the advances are reclassified to the investment account.
Debit logic: Dr 116002 Investment – Acquisition of PRJ-02 Interest (Completed), or 116011 where the interest is that of a named individual
Required dimensions: Project = PRJ-02 · Counterparty
Required documents: Completed transfer documentation and board resolution
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-37 completion requires a board resolution reference

Business event: Eligible project development cost is capitalised into Concession Assets under Construction.
Credit logic: Cr advance, payable, cash or shareholder loan
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty · Asset Class · Handover Requirement · CAPEX/OPEX = CAPEX
Required documents: Invoice, certificate or contract evidencing the cost
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-38 115030 is a non-posting parent and may not be posted to

Transaction Type (EN): Transfer from CIP to Concession & Operating Right
النوع (عربي): تحويل من قيد الإنشاء إلى حق الامتياز
Business event: At commercial operation, eligible concession costs transfer from CIP to the concession right.
Required dimensions: Project · Asset Class
Required documents: Commercial operation certificate and board approval of the transfer schedule
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-39 blocked until the commercial operation date parameter is set — the system must never assume one

Business event: The concession right is amortized over the remaining contract term from the commercial operation date.
Required dimensions: Project
Required documents: Amortization schedule approved by the Finance Manager
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-39 · VR-40 amortization may not be posted before the commercial operation date

Business event: A movable asset retained by SHH is acquired.
Credit logic: Cr cash, payable, advance or shareholder loan
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty · Asset Class = Fixed Asset (Retained)
Required documents: Purchase invoice and asset receipt

Business event: Periodic depreciation of retained fixed assets.
Required dimensions: Cost Center · Project
Required documents: Approved depreciation schedule
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-41 depreciation runs only in an open period

Business event: Operating revenue of the yard is earned.
Debit logic: Dr 111xxx cash / bank or 112001 Trade Receivables
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Revenue type · Counterparty where applicable
Required documents: Revenue report from the operating system, receipt or invoice
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-22 · VR-42 revenue must carry an eligibility flag for the government share

Business event: The State Company share is computed on eligible revenue for the period and recognised.
Credit logic: Cr 213001 State Company for Land Transport – 20% Share Payable
Required dimensions: Project · Period · Revenue population reference
Required documents: Computation sheet showing eligible revenue, rate and period
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-43 the rate comes from the parameter table, never from code · VR-44 the base excludes funding, loans, asset disposals and refunds

Business event: The accrued government share is paid to the State Company.
Required dimensions: Cash/Bank account · Counterparty = State Company for Land Transport
Required documents: Payment voucher and government receipt

Business event: A cost relating to the period is recognised before invoice or payment.
Credit logic: Cr 211010 Accrued Expenses or 211011 Salaries Payable
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty where known · Period
Required documents: Accrual computation approved by the Senior Accountant
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-45 accruals must be reversed or settled in the following period

Business event: A cost paid in advance is carried and released over the benefit period.
Debit logic: On payment: Dr 113001–113009 / on release: Dr 510xxx or 610xxx
Credit logic: On payment: Cr cash or payable / on release: Cr 113xxx
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Counterparty · Period range
Required documents: Contract or policy showing the benefit period
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-46 release may not exceed the carried balance

Business event: The amount physically received differs from the amount funded and the cause is not yet determined.
Credit logic: Cr the advance or cash account
Required dimensions: Project · Cost Center · Responsibility Center · Advance Holder
Required documents: Note of the discrepancy; evidence pending
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-47 a suspense posting automatically creates an open exception

Business event: The cause of a suspense item is established and the item is moved to its final account.
Required dimensions: All dimensions of the final account
Required documents: Evidence establishing the correct treatment
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-48 clearance closes the linked exception and records the resolution

Business event: A posted entry carries the wrong account and the board approves the correction.
Required dimensions: Same dimensions as the original entry, plus a link to the original JV
Required documents: Board or Finance Manager approval naming the JV, the old account and the new account
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-49 a reclassification must never credit an advance account a second time · VR-50 amount, date, description and source reference may not change

Business event: A posted entry is reversed in full under approval.
Debit logic: Mirror of the original credit side
Credit logic: Mirror of the original debit side
Required dimensions: Same dimensions as the original, plus reversal reason and link
Required documents: Written reason and approval
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-51 a posted entry may not be edited or deleted — only reversed · VR-52 reversal must post to an open period

Business event: A shareholder contributes capital, initially pending registration, later registered.
Debit logic: On contribution: Dr cash / on registration: Dr 310010
Credit logic: On contribution: Cr 310010 / on registration: Cr 310001–310004
Required dimensions: Shareholder · Cash account
Required documents: Capital contribution evidence and the registration certificate

Business event: A shareholder loan is repaid in cash or converted to equity.
Credit logic: Cr 111xxx on repayment, or 310010 on conversion
Required dimensions: Shareholder · Cash account where repaid
Required documents: Board resolution; payment evidence where repaid
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-20 spending project funds NEVER reduces a shareholder loan — only repayment, conversion or an approved documented settlement does

Business event: The current result is transferred to retained earnings at year end.
Debit logic: Dr 310040 Current-Year Result (or Cr where a loss)
Credit logic: Cr 310030 Retained Earnings (or Dr where a loss)
Required dimensions: Entity · Fiscal Year
Required documents: Approved annual financial statements
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-53 permitted only after the final close of the last period of the year

Business event: Historical balances or historical journal entries are loaded at go-live.
Required dimensions: All dimensions carried from the source, with source file and source row recorded
Required documents: The approved source workbook
Control rules: VR-01 · VR-54 migration entries carry an immutable source reference and may not be created after go-live
